policy: Open-source first. Do not copy code before license and dependency review.

candidates.name: volcengine/rtc-aigc-demo
candidates.why: Closest to the default Doubao/Volcengine supplier path and can validate Chinese ASR/TTS, RTC Web access, account permissions, and latency.

candidates.name: livekit/agents
candidates.module: Realtime voice agent and WebRTC transport
candidates.why: Strong reference for server-side voice agents, browser SDK, STT/LLM/TTS plugins, VAD, turn detection, and interruption semantics.

candidates.name: pipecat-ai/pipecat
candidates.why: Good reference for realtime voice pipelines, WebSocket/WebRTC transports, VAD, STT/TTS/LLM composition, and metrics.

candidates.name: snakers4/silero-vad
candidates.why: Useful for detecting elder speech start during assistant playback and reducing fake interruption completion.
spikeEvidenceRequired: integration path through LiveKit or Pipecat

candidates.name: giztoy/doubao-speech-go
candidates.why: Can clarify Doubao operations such as session open, audio send, interrupt, and close, but it is a third-party library and not the SGX frontend architecture.
spikeEvidenceRequired: event names mapped to SGX provider contract
no direct dependency decision before review
